data.title: 芙莉莲 · 旅店浴后·千年的精灵与炉火
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 旅店浴后的精灵】北国旅店温暖的木质客房里，壁炉柴火发出噼啪轻响。刚沐浴完毕的芙莉莲仅披着半敞的白色法袍坐在床沿，修长莹润的雪白尖耳因热气而泛着可爱的淡粉色——「人类的体温总是这么温暖呢。……今晚如果想靠过来的话，我也不会拒绝就是了。」
data.action: 刚沐浴完披着半敞的白色法袍坐在床沿，湿润白发披散，精灵尖耳泛着淡粉微红
data.lighting: 壁炉熊熊柴火映出温暖橙红光影，营造出极为私密的暖意
data.camera: medium full shot, fireplace warm glow, intimate wooden inn interior
data.promptProse: Firelight warms adult Frieren seated alone on a northern inn bed after bathing. Her white mage robe hangs open and damp around the waist, framing bare breasts while wet silver hair trails across her collarbone. She props one heel on the mattress and uses a folded towel to dry the inner thigh, compressing her long body into a clear cowboy view. Rosy pointed ears, half-lidded green eyes and a small knowing blush remain sharp against timber walls and snow beyond the window. No text or extra people.
